subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HJR9
title: Proposes an amendment to the Oregon Constitution to change when elections that consider the recall of an elected official must take place and to require the recall measure to be placed on the ballot for the next regularly scheduled election following the recall petition certification, or the following regularly scheduled election if the recall petition certification occurs after the filing deadline for the first election.
headline: HJR 9 did not pass

claims.text: HJR 9 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HJR 9 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
HJR 9 is a proposed change to the Oregon Constitution. It would have gone to voters if passed; it did not pass, so it will not be on your ballot.
